苕云: Tiaoyun, Wang Youling’s youngest son, aged five; pronunciation inferred from name, not externally verified
江老大: Boatman Jiang / Jiang; surname pun with River retained
王老爷（胡假姓）: Mr Wang, Hu Xueyan’s assumed surname when addressing Boatman Jiang
马蹄银: horseshoe-shaped silver ingot; no amount specified for initial boat hire
美孚油: Mobil kerosene; brand retained from source despite possible historical anachronism
善棍: charity swindlers, distinct from people doing genuinely helpful acts for reputation
陆德义: Lu Deyi, Taiping junior commander from Hanyang
新家伙: new fellow, Taiping term for a newly seized civilian
天京/天王: the Heavenly Capital / the Heavenly King
妖风发了: The demon wind is up! — Taiping cry announcing an attack by imperial troops
